description:
Create a new project dashboard named 'Sprint 1 Review' in the TailwindTraders project to provide a status snapshot for stakeholders.

The dashboard must contain at least 4 configured widgets:
1. A Markdown widget named 'Sprint Goals' containing this exact text:
   - Complete product inventory search feature
   - Fix all Priority 1 bugs
   - Achieve 80% code coverage on new modules
2. A Query Tile widget showing the count of 'Active Bugs' (use the shared query).
3. A Chart for Work Items widget showing 'Sprint 1 All Items' grouped by 'State' (use the shared query).
4. One additional widget of your choice (e.g., Burndown, Assigned to Me).

To start, navigate to Overview > Dashboards. You may need to browse shared queries to find the required data sources.
